visual_source_files.evidence: README embeds framework.png under the exact CoCo paper title; manual comparison with the rendered PDF Figure 1 shows the same local/global, compactness, and consistency composition.

pdf_format and plot_tsne define Times New Roman, point marker ., s=10, axes off, eight class colors, sample_num=2000, and TSNE random_state=0; no composite 2x7 layout or stored embedding files are present.

source_acquisition.search_note: The PDF explicitly links https://github.com/juweipku/CoCo and the README title/author block matches the target paper; OpenReview is https://openreview.net/forum?id=9jdQLmPUHW. The automated visual_source_inventory row reports repository_without_visual_source and no local corpus/visual_sources directory, but a direct gh recursive tree inspection found framework.png and tSNE.py. No other repository was returned by exact-title gh search. The repository has no Table 1-10 generator and no Figure 2/4/5/6/7 plotting/export source, so only Figure 1 and part of Figure 3 have public visual support.

paper_style.palette_strategy: Tables use black text and thin booktabs-like rules, pale pink CoCo highlighting, blue/purple runner-up highlighting, and occasional pale yellow loss/iteration cells. Figures use independent grammars: six categorical bars (Figure 2), green-to-red ordinal bars (Figures 4/6), multi-hue class points (Figure 3), pale runtime/memory backgrounds (Figure 5), and two-color lines (Figure 7).
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF text/tables, Figure 2, Figure 6, and Figure 7 are predominantly vector; Figures 1, 3, 4, and 5 contain embedded raster/composite image resources. Captions and surrounding prose are vector.
paper_style.style_consistency: Nimbus Roman No9 L and Computer Modern math are stable in captions/tables, while chart/diagram text uses Times New Roman-like raster or vector subsets. Table highlight conventions recur, but chart palettes have local semantics and no shared legend; small inset text and 3D sensitivity bars reduce cross-object comparability.

design_strengths: One wide diagram puts the two views, shared compactness operation, and relational consistency in one readable chain.
Arrows and formula labels align the visual stages with Eq.1-7.

The caption only names the framework and cannot explain the EM loop or anchor distributions alone.

figures.evidence_relation: §3.4 representation separability question -> Figure 3 two-dataset/seven-method qualitative comparison -> Table 1 quantitative clustering -> Figure 4 and Appendix Figure 6 sensitivity.
design_strengths: Fourteen panels make local inter-cluster mixing and separation differences directly visible.
Fixed method columns and two dataset rows support side-by-side reading.
Caption at least identifies the row-to-dataset mapping.
design_weaknesses: No class-color legend or axes means the figure is not independently reproducible from the caption.
t-SNE geometry is qualitative and does not establish a scalar effect.
Only Cora and AMAP are shown, without projection stability or seed variation.
figures.reusable_pattern: Keep methods as fixed columns and datasets as rows, but add class legend/marker redundancy and caption the sample count, seed, and observable separation criterion.

caption.text: Table 1: Clustering performance on five benchmark datasets (mean ± standard deviation). The top two results for each method are marked in bold and underline, respectively.

The phrase “top two results for each method” is ambiguous about the ranking unit.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 compresses the two diagnosed gaps into local/global views -> low-rank compactness -> consistency. Table 1 supplies the overall clustering headline; Figure 2 and Table 2 separate components and loss choices; Figure 3 gives a qualitative representation slice; Figure 4 and Appendix Figure 6 sweep K/M/alpha; Tables 3-5 test noise and graph types; Figure 5 and Table 6 expose empirical costs; Table 7 tests downstream transfer; Appendix Table 8-10 and Figure 7 add theory, full loss/sensitivity, and filter-depth robustness.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions are short Figure/Table N noun phrases. Table 1/9 define mean±standard deviation and top-two styling; Figure 3 defines row-to-dataset mapping; Table 7 defines OOM. Most other captions omit settings, color/marker keys, uncertainty, units, or the main finding, so they are not self-contained.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Tables use shaded bold headers with Dataset/Metric or Dataset/Loss at the left and repeated ACC/NMI/ARI/F1 columns. Tables 4/5 and 6 use two-level method or dataset headers; dataset row groups are separated by horizontal rules and proposed cells/rows use pale fills.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1’s view, compactness, and consistency modules are tested by Figure 2 M1-M5 grouped bars, Table 2/10 MSE-InfoNCE-Consistency rows, and Figure 4/6 K-M-alpha sensitivity. Table 1/9 and Tables 3-5 provide outcomes but do not directly measure redundancy removal or long-range capture.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: The main text retains one overview, a primary comparison, selected loss/component/sensitivity checks, robustness/cost slices, and transfer. Appendix A-E provide EM/proofs/algorithm/complexity, F fixes run/configuration details, G-H expand baseline/loss tables, I-J expand sensitivity/filter robustness, and K supplies related work. Table 2->10 and Figure 4->6 are isomorphic extensions.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Body/caption/table text is predominantly Nimbus Roman No9 L with Computer Modern math; chart text is near Times New Roman. Table body sizes are about 6-7.3 pt and chart labels about 4-8 pt, with captions near 10 pt. Bold marks headers, CoCo, and selected best values.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Pale pink generally marks CoCo cells/rows, blue-purple marks runner-ups, and pale yellow marks loss or iteration labels. Figure 1/2/3/4/5/6/7 otherwise use local color semantics with no shared legend; Figure 3 and green-to-red sensitivity charts are not grayscale-safe, while Figure 7 has marker redundancy.

most_reusable_patterns: A three-stage architecture diagram links parallel views, shared compression/reconstruction, and relational loss.
Main and appendix tables preserve Dataset/Metric/loss row groups, precision, and highlight grammar.
Grouped bars plus surrogate-loss tables plus sensitivity small multiples separate component, objective, and hyperparameter questions.
ACC-versus-runtime/memory scatter and EM-time table put utility and resource cost on a common decision chain.
highest_value_objects: Figure 1: method interface and evidence-chain anchor.
Figure 2 plus Table 2: component and consistency-loss ablations.
Figure 5 plus Table 6: empirical efficiency and EM iteration choice.
failure_patterns: Figure 3 omits axes and a class-color legend, so t-SNE evidence is qualitative and hard to reproduce from the caption.
Figures 4 and 6 use dense 3D bars without a legend, uncertainty, or exact labels; perspective limits quantitative reading.
Narrow inset objects use small type and captions often omit settings, units, run counts, and uncertainty definitions.
The prose percentage gains around Table 1 do not align cleanly with visible runner-ups, and Table 7’s universal “all datasets” claim conflicts with the Coauthor Physics cells.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: CoCo opens with a local/global -> low-rank compactness -> consistency architecture and closes the chain with main comparisons, component/loss ablations, qualitative separation, sensitivity/robustness, and cost tables, but leaves direct mechanism measurements and caption self-sufficiency secondary to final performance.
